data.long_meaning: Kalindika is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kalindi', which refers to the river Yamuna. The name Kalindika carries the meaning “Daughter of the river Yamuna” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kalindika usually hope their child will grow to embody daughter of the river yamuna and live with faith, good character and purpose.
